Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly conflated “Myra” (Mayra Ambriz, the Disney pop singer who performed “Step Into The Light”) with “Mýa” (a different artist), and even proposed treating “myra” and “mya” as equivalent with a popularity prior. This misidentification directed the search toward the wrong artist and would lead to an incorrect birthplace.
